title: asplenium theciferum subsp. concinnum
intro: Asplenium theciferum subsp. concinnum, commonly known as the New Zealand shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Aspleniaceae. It is a type of medicinal plant used in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Asplenium theciferum subsp. concinnum are thought to include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and other compounds that may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
